segments.name: Development, manufacturing and commercialization of novel therapeutics
segments.description: A clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company developing therapeutic antibodies for patients with severe inflammatory, allergic and autoimmune diseases.
segments.evidence: The Company is managed as a single operating and reportable segment that operates in the business of development, manufacturing and commercialization of novel therapeutics for human health care.

revenueModel.text: The company has had no commercial revenues from drug sales; its revenue comes from license arrangements, primarily with Rockefeller University.
revenueModel.evidence: We have had no commercial revenues from sales of our drug candidates, and we have had a history of operating losses.
